record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: If two disjoint Cauchy surfaces in an asymptotically flat vacuum spacetime are isometric as initial data, must the spacetime be stationary, meaning that it admits a timelike Killing vector field?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\mathcal{S}, g_{\rm st})$ be a $(3+1)$-dimensional asymptotically flat vacuum spacetime, i.e. a smooth Lorentzian 4-manifold satisfying the vacuum Einstein equations $\mathrm{Ric}(g_{\rm st})=0$ and possessing an end diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}\times(\mathbb{R}^3\setminus B)$ on which $g_{\rm st}$ approaches the Minkowski metric at suitable rates. An initial data set on a spacelike hypersurface $M\subset\mathcal{S}$ consists of the pair $(g,K)$, where $g$ is the Riemannian metric induced on $M$ by $g_{\rm st}$ and $K$ is its second fundamental form in $\mathcal{S}$.

Suppose $(M_1,g_1,K_1)$ and $(M_2,g_2,K_2)$ are two disjoint Cauchy surfaces of $\mathcal{S}$ (with their induced initial data) for which there exists a diffeomorphism $\varphi:M_1\to M_2$ such that
$$\varphi^*g_2 = g_1,\qquad \varphi^*K_2 = K_1.$$

Prove or disprove: under these hypotheses, $\mathcal{S}$ is stationary, i.e. it admits a timelike Killing vector field.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a definitive resolution of this isometric-Cauchy-surfaces-implies-stationarity question for asymptotically flat vacuum spacetimes. Related results exist on Killing vectors in asymptotically flat spacetimes (e.g. Beig–Chruściel), extensions of Killing fields beyond Cauchy horizons, and the Bartnik stationary vacuum conjecture, but none of these appear to settle the precise question of whether the existence of two isometric disjoint Cauchy data on an AF vacuum spacetime forces a timelike Killing field. Status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Killing vectors in asymptotically flat space–times
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of Killing vector fields in asymptotically flat space-times; rigidity part of the positive energy theorem and absence of asymptotically null Killing vectors except in Minkowski.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on existence/rigidity of Killing fields in AF spacetimes, but not the specific isometric-Cauchy-surfaces problem.

status_evidence.title: Extension of Killing vector fields beyond compact Cauchy horizons
status_evidence.snippet: Extension of Killing vector fields beyond compact Cauchy horizons in vacuum.
status_evidence.claim: Related rigidity/extension results for Killing fields, not a direct resolution.

status_evidence.title: Monotonicity of Causal Killing Vectors and Geometry of ADM Mass Minimizers
status_evidence.snippet: Positive Bartnik mass minimizers embed into strongly stationary vacuum spacetimes, confirming the Bartnik stationary vacuum conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Stationary vacuum conjectures of related flavor exist; question of isometric Cauchy surfaces remains separate.
